description: This file implements an HTML rendering backend for the Blackfriday Markdown processor, including configuration options, HTML tag handling, and rendering logic for Markdown nodes to HTML.

classes.name: HTMLRenderer
classes.description: Implements the Renderer interface for HTML output, managing rendering state and configuration.

methods.name: NewHTMLRenderer
methods.description: Creates and configures a new HTMLRenderer instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: RenderHeader
methods.description: Writes the HTML document preamble and optional table of contents.

methods.name: RenderFooter
methods.description: Writes the closing tags for the HTML document if CompletePage is set.

methods.name: writeDocumentHeader
methods.description: Outputs the HTML document header including doctype, head, and opening body tags.

methods.name: writeTOC
methods.description: Generates a table of contents based on the document's heading nodes.

methods.name: RenderNode
methods.description: Renders individual Markdown nodes to HTML, handling different node types and entering/exiting states.

methods.name: out
methods.description: Outputs text to the writer, optionally stripping HTML tags if disabled.

methods.name: cr
methods.description: Outputs a newline if the last output was non-empty.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Outputs an HTML tag with attributes.

methods.name: ensureUniqueHeadingID
methods.description: Ensures heading IDs are unique within the document.

methods.name: addAbsPrefix
methods.description: Adds absolute URL prefix to relative links if configured.

methods.name: appendLinkAttrs
methods.description: Appends link attributes based on flags and link safety.

methods.name: isMailto
methods.description: Checks if a link is a mailto link.

methods.name: needSkipLink
methods.description: Determines if a link should be skipped based on security flags.

methods.name: headingTagsFromLevel
methods.description: Returns the appropriate heading tags for a given level.
